layers.authority: AUTOCOLCA (Autoridad Autónoma del Colca y Anexos), a public body created by Law 24521 of 1986 and now attached to the Caylloma provincial municipality by Arequipa Regional Ordinance 141
layers.process: Visitors to the Colca Canyon, Salinas and Aguada Blanca reserve and Valley of the Volcanoes circuit need the AUTOCOLCA tourist ticket plus photo identity (passport). It is bought online or at the Chivay control centre (daily 5:00 am to 6:00 pm). Foreign adult S/ 70 (soles; no AUD conversion given because the RBA list has no sol rate), child 6 to 15 years S/ 20; a cheaper Latin American adult rate of S/ 40 applies to citizens and residents of 18 listed countries. The ticket is valid from the day of purchase and for one use only. It covers entry only, not a guide or transport, and does not include La Calera hot springs or the Uyo Uyo ruins.
